title: My times are in your hand

request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and resilient, solo with soft choir backing, strings, piano, harp, cello, hopeful and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I am forgotten out of mind like the dead
Broken vessel cast away on the street
Whispering of many surrounds me in fear
They conspire against me and plot to kill

[Chorus]
But I trust in you LORD I say you are my God
My times are in your hand deliver me now
Save me from the grip of those who pursue
Let your face shine upon your servant true

[Verse]
Terror surrounds me as they plot my end
I hear the voices of the crowd
They speak with pride and arrogance
Against the righteous with contempt

[Chorus]
But I trust in you LORD I say you are my God
My times are in your hand deliver me now
Save me from the grip of those who pursue
Let your face shine upon your servant true

[Bridge]
Let the wicked be put to shame in the grave
Let lying lips be struck dumb and silent
I have called on you let me not be ashamed
Your mercy is my only shield

[Chorus]
But I trust in you LORD I say you are my God
My times are in your hand deliver me now
Save me from the grip of those who pursue
Let your face shine upon your servant true
